name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit while holding the box, which is a hard goal. The current clauses only contain hard rules (Response and ChainResponse) and no hard Existence clause, so the machine has no FINAL_STATES (rule‑only warning). Add a hard goal clause, e.g. a hard Existence(at_exit) (or a combined goal that ensures holding_box at exit), which together with the existing Response(at_exit, holding_box) will satisfy the task. Without this goal the task’s main requirement is missing.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The three hard clauses correctly capture “carry the box to the exit” (Existence(at_exit) + Response(at_exit, holding_box)) and the “if the box falls, pick it up on the very next move” (ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)). No extra or missing requirements are present.

texts: When the agent reaches the exit, it must be holding the box
If the box falls, the agent must pick it up again on the very next move
